native.krf_edition: Actual reviewed KNX2.1 RF edition versus separately registered newer/other profile; no automatic SLE/region conformance.
native.krf_variant: Actual RF1Ready/Multi/BiBat/BiBat2,433MHzRF2/3,915MHzRF4 or separately registeredSLE; not one generic wireless setting.
native.krf_channel: Actual single ready/BiBat channel versus MultiF1/F2/F3/S1/S2 or BiBat2F4; receiver compatibility is required.
native.krf_role: Actual original endpoint versus repeater versus independently qualified media coupler.
native.krf_direction: Actual transmit versus receive; observed radio fields differ from transmitter limits.
native.krf_device_direction: Actual unidirectional transmit-only versus bidirectional radio capability; no constructorfalse assumption.
native.krf_receiver_mode: Actual permanent/non-permanent/absent receiver, not assumed from mains/battery supply.
native.krf_frame_kind: Actual RF Ready asynchronous, Multi data/ACK, BiBat sync/help/fastACK/long-header or registered service.
native.krf_access_kind: Actual original/repeated/ACK-repeater channel-access table row; priority is not encoded like CAN.
native.krf_telegram_format: Actual standard versus LTE extended or separately registered secured/management layout.
native.krf_communication: Actual individual connected/connectionless, multicast, domain/system broadcast; AET selectsSN/DoA.
native.krf_modulation: Actual FSK or qualified registered modulation; not inferred from generic radio.
native.krf_encoding: Actual Manchester two chips per bit versus explicit registered encoding.
native.krf_bib_master_role: Actual BiBat master versus slave versus synchronous repeater; down/up roles differ.
native.krf_bib_traffic_direction: Actual master downstream versus slave upstream or management frame.
native.krf_commissioning_mode: Actual S-Mode versus PB preassigned datagrams; factory group-number rule is not universal.
native.krf_revision: Actual selected full physical/link/security edition and compatible device capabilities.
native.krf_registered_profile_source: Actual registered alternate/current/SLE/RF4/channel/service parameter schema and codec; old incomplete RF4 table is not evidence.
native.krf_device_source: Actual radio chip/antenna/firmware, supported Ready/Multi/BiBat/channel/receiver capabilities.
native.krf_regulatory_source: Actual current deployment jurisdiction, band/power/duty/LBT and applicable radio approval;2013 limits are not current permission.
native.krf_binding_source: Actual canonical RF port, selected independent channel/domain and registered TP/IP/media-coupler paths.
native.krf_commissioning_source: Actual unique commissioned domain/member serials/group mappings/receiver capabilities and secure keys.
native.krf_application_source: Actual DPT/APCI/LTE application codec and payload, not all255bytes application data.
native.krf_schedule_source: Actual airtime, receiver scanning/wake-up/channel access/repeats/ACKs and BiBat synchronization.
native.krf_capacity_source: Actual complete shared radio domain/coexistence/channel duty/transport/coupler capacity evidence.
native.krf_acceptance_source: Actual functional E2E/freshness/safety acceptance, distinct from localLData.con or radio ACK.
native.krf_serial_hex: Actual6-byte sender serial; constructorzero is not allocation.
native.krf_domain_hex: Actual6-byte commissioned RF domain;2013 allocation from memberSN differs from newer ETS domain policy.
native.krf_domain_member_serial_hex: Actual domain-owner/member serial for the2013 allocation rule, not invented reference identity.
native.krf_wire_address_hex: Actual transmitted6-byte SN orDoA selected by AET.
native.krf_receiver_source: Actual configured recipients, fast/slow capability, scan state/slots and address acceptance.
native.krf_ack_source: Actual FastAck-capable recipients/unique configured slots/expected list and real missing-ACK handling.
native.krf_bib_master_serial_hex: Actual BiBat master serial used as synchronous domain, not zero/defaultmaster.
native.krf_bib_schedule_source: Actual commissioned BiBat64slot/128block/pseudorandom table and receive-window alignment.
native.krf_security_source: Actual independently commissioned KNX Data Secure per group/endpoint, not KNX IP Secure radio transport.
native.krf_group_key_ref: Actual protected group key reference; no secret key/defaultcredentials.
native.krf_coupler_source: Actual RF-TP/RF-IP mapping, frame capability, translation latency, filtering and independently sized other medium.
native.krf_crc_source: Actual byte-order/no-reflection/initial-zero/complemented FT3 CRC16 source and test vector.
native.krf_bitrate_bps: Actual information bits/s;fast16384 versus slow8192, not chiprate32768.
native.krf_carrier_hz: Actual selected carrier frequency, not generic868MHz for all RF variants.
native.krf_bandwidth_hz: Actual modulation bandwidth; edition/channel upper limit is not an operating default.
native.krf_deviation_hz: Actual FSK deviation magnitude;fast typical60000,slow range has no supplied universal typical.
native.krf_tx_erp_dbm: Actual radiated transmitterERP,2013 typical0dBm proposal only; power affects duty policy.
native.krf_tx_erp_mw: Actual radiatedERPmW for channel/power-dependent duty branch, distinct from chip conducted power.
native.krf_duty_percent: Actual air-time proportion within qualified regulatory observation window, not maxlimit default.
native.krf_duty_window_ms: Actual applicable duty-cycle observation window from current radio approval.
native.krf_tx_frequency_error_ppm: Actual magnitude of transmit frequency error including aging/temperature.
native.krf_rx_frequency_tolerance_ppm: Actual qualified receive frequency tolerance;specifiedminimum is not measuredclockerror.
native.krf_tx_chip_error_percent: Actual magnitude of transmit encoded-chip timing error.
native.krf_rx_chip_tolerance_percent: Actual supported receive chiprate tolerance at statedBER/direction.
native.krf_tx_jitter_us: Actual magnitude of chip transition jitter.
native.krf_rx_sensitivity_dbm: Actual radiated sensitivity at specifiedBER/antenna orientation.
native.krf_test_ber: Actual sensitivity/test BER criterion, not an assumed zero runtime error probability.
native.krf_link_budget_db: Actual link budget from qualified transmitter and receiver, recommended100dB is not measurement.
native.krf_operating_min_c: Actual device operating-temperature lower limit, exampleoutdoor temperature is not standard default.
native.krf_blocking_category: Actual receiver blocking category per applicable edition/radio standard.
native.krf_preamble_chips: Actual physical preamble chips, distinct from data octets and pairs.
native.krf_violation_chips: Actual Manchester violation6chips for revieweddata frames.
native.krf_sync_chips: Actual revieweddata sync12chips; special ACK structure separately encoded.
native.krf_postamble_chips: Actual2..8chip basic trailer versus special extendedACK/postamble.
native.krf_interframe_ms: Actual fixed quiet-medium interval by role/frame/channel, notCAN arbitration.
native.krf_random_ms: Actual random backoff, discrete1msstep with exclusiveupperbound in reviewedtable; no fixed zeroexample default.
native.krf_medium_access_ms: Actual interframe+randomtime after current channel free, not a whole application latency guarantee.
native.krf_channel_timeout_ms: Actual Multi channel blockage timeout fast500/slow1500ms.
native.krf_length_field: Actual L octet counts useroctets afterL excludingCRCs;255reserved in reviewed edition.
native.krf_user_octets: Actual total RF user octets includingL and firstblock,excludingCRCs/pre/postamble.
native.krf_block_count: Actual first10-byteblock plusceil(remaining/16), each block has2CRCbytes.
native.krf_crc_octets: Actual per-block CRC2bytes, distinct from one end-of-frame CANCRC.
native.krf_crc_polynomial: Actual non-reflected FT3 polynomial0x3D65, not reflected genericDNP implementation parameter.
native.krf_crc_initial: Actual non-reflected FT3 initialzero, not optional frame evidence bypass.
native.krf_crc_xorout: Actual complemented FT3 result0xFFFF, MSB-first onwire.
native.krf_c_field: ActualSEND_NO_REPLY C0x44, not availability of Multi fastACK.
native.krf_lfn: Actual3-bit RF linkframe number for duplicate elimination, not TCPsequence.
native.krf_repetition_counter: Actual3-bitRF repetition counter;2013Ready/BiBat endpoint6 versusMulti2, not sendretrycount.
native.krf_received_repetition_counter: Actual received counter before repeater decrement, notdefault6 for repeatingframes.
native.krf_eff: Actual4-bit extendedframe format;standard0, LTE uses registeredtagformats.
native.krf_apci: Actual selected10-bitapplicationservice encoding, not allassignments valid for everyDPT.
native.krf_lte_iot: Actual16-bit LTE interface object type, assigned by selected application spec.
native.krf_lte_instance: Actual LTE object instance from selected application codec.
native.krf_lte_pid: Actual LTE property ID from selected application schema.
native.krf_domain_participants: Actual commissioned devices per RF domain, association limit255.
native.krf_repeaters: Actual commissioned retransmitters per RF domain, at most3; no assumedzero.
native.krf_ack_slot: Actual unique configured receiver slot, not automaticallyslot1.
native.krf_ack_start_us: Actual ACK starts100..300us after fastslot start, slowtimingsdouble.
native.krf_ack_postamble_ms: Actual special MultiFastpostamble9ms, slowtimingsdouble; extraEOA structure accounted separately.
native.krf_echo_timeout_ms: Actual repeater echo wait75ms for reviewedfastchannel; qualifiedslow-frame processing/echo timing needs actual source.
native.krf_bib_pause_ms: ActualBiBat pseudorandompause from commissioned48-bitmaster-derivedtable, not fixed500ms.
native.payload_bytes: Actual reviewed DPT/LTE application bytes, distinct from RF L-count/first10byteblock/following16byteblocks/CRCs/radio pre-postamble/Data Secure wrapper; no universal8byte default or255byte application bound.
